commands.name: register
commands.description: Register an extension in Didot's extension registry.

options.name: --name
options.description: Friendly name override for the registered extension.

arguments.name: REFERENCE
arguments.description: Extension reference (id/name, assembly path, or directory path).

options.name: --engine
options.description: The template engine to use or to enforce when rendering the template.

options.name: --engine-extension
options.description: Associate a file's extension to a specific template engine.

options.name: --source
options.description: The source file(s) to use when rendering the template. The key is an optional identifier for the source that can be used in the template to reference it. If only one source file is provided without a key, it will be associated with an empty string key. This option cannot be used together with --stdin.

options.name: --stdin
options.description: Indicates that the input will come from stdin.

options.name: --parser
options.description: The parser to use when reading from StdIn or to enforce when reading from files.

options.name: --parser-extension
options.description: Associate a file's extension to a specific parser.

options.name: --parser-parameter
options.description: Provide key-value parameters for parsers, such as configuration or dialect settings.

options.name: --output
options.description: Path to the output file. If not provided, the rendered template will be written to stdout.
